title: Existence and multiplicity of solutions to the mean-field games model with mixed interactions
summary: In this paper, we consider the stationary version of the Mean-Field Games (MFG) models. Inspired by \cite{Albuquerque-Silva2020, Bieganowski-Mederski2021, Lin-Wei05, Mederski-Schino2021}, we develop the minimization method on the Pohozaev manifold introduced in \cite{Soave20JDE, Soave20JFA} for the existence theory of the stationary version of the Mean-Field Games (MFG) models with $2$-homogeneous hamiltonians and mixed interactions.
